income_measurement.realized_reason: Payroll issuance is verified, but gross and payment proof remain behind the user's authenticated payroll portal; missing evidence is not converted to zero.
income_measurement.contracted_reason: No accepted assignments beyond 2026-08-11 or binding event assignments were read back.
income_measurement.pipeline_reason: No new paid-work contact, current app inventory, or accepted event assignment was observed.

historical_capacity.interpretation: The direct 18-shift path is feasible but is not supported as the central case without changed availability or assignment supply.

primary_safe_path.activation_gate: Current physically safe, non-overlapping app jobs with combined displayed gross of at least JPY 20,800 must be read back and personally accepted by the user.

direct_employment_path.historical_observation: At least 18 unique assigned dates occurred in 1 of 12 observed pay periods.

achievement_days.definition: Days until verified trailing-30-day gross income or a binding next-30-day gross run rate is at least JPY 200,000.

rationale.p20: First target-period verification around 2026-09-25 if the availability intervention yields 18 primary shifts or the conditional 16-plus-2 hybrid is activated.
rationale.p50: One additional pay-period cycle, verified around 2026-10-25, because 18 shifts occurred in only 1 of 12 observed periods and current event inventory is unverified.
rationale.p80: Allows roughly three additional monthly cycles and continued source substitution through late December if assignment supply stays near the recent 13-shift mean.
rationale.calibration_note: The prior forecast assumed 18 distributed shifts as the central path before twelve-period capacity was measured. This update lengthens the quantified forecast instead of preserving an unsupported optimistic assumption.
rationale.conditional_shortening: A current safe event-app read-back and two accepted jobs totaling at least JPY 20,800 can restore the first-cycle hybrid path without increasing total workdays beyond 18.

maintenance_confirmation_days.definition: Two measurements at least 30 days apart are each at least JPY 200,000, with evidence that the following 30 days continue.

priority_paths.path: existing employment plus formally hired event-staff hybrid
priority_paths.action: Request a safe four-primary-day weekly pattern and personally accept at most two non-overlapping event jobs only when their combined displayed gross is at least JPY 20,800 and every safety gate passes.
priority_paths.dependency: Sixteen accepted primary shifts, current event inventory, safe commute, and user acceptance.

priority_paths.action: Keep requesting a safe 4–5 day-shift weekly pattern; count only accepted assignments.
priority_paths.dependency: Eighteen accepted day shifts; observed once in twelve pay periods.

priority_paths.action: Rescan only leads above the rejected unverified marketplace layer and require client, privacy, smartphone, effective-pay, and payment gates.

priority_paths.role: Optional upside, not the critical path without demand or conversion evidence.

minimum_user_operation.cadence: one batched phone session this week
steps: In the normal shift form, submit only physically safe dates for the week beginning 2026-08-16, aiming for four primary day shifts with rest; keep requesting toward sixteen accepted primary shifts in the pay period.
In the same Gmail session, open the unread 2026-07-24 payroll notice, tap its payroll link, and read only gross pay.

Only if the existing event-work app is already installed and logged in, inspect full terms for jobs on dates not requested or accepted by the primary employer. Personally apply to at most two only when they are physically safe, the commute and return are safe, and their combined displayed gross is at least JPY 20,800. Otherwise do not apply and report the highest displayed gross or no eligible job.
minimum_user_operation.minimization_reason: The request remains one phone session. Historical measurement replaces an unlikely single-employer 18-shift dependency with a mathematically sufficient 16-plus-2 option while preserving the no-install/no-reregistration fallback.
minimum_user_operation.secret_warning: Do not send screenshots, credentials, verification codes, payslip contents other than gross pay, addresses, or identifiers.
minimum_user_operation.completion_signal: Return only '総支給額=金額／現職4勤務希望済み／イベント応募=件数・合計金額' or 'イベント対象なし' or 'イベントアプリ未使用'.

biggest_uncertainties: User physical availability and safe workload
Employer acceptance of requested primary shifts
Current event-app inventory, gross, commute, and acceptance
Gross amount and payment proof behind the authenticated payroll portal
The separate effects of user availability and employer supply in historical shift counts
privacy: No employer name, person name, coworker, address, email, phone, account identifier, message identifier, or secret is stored.
